story_hole: Existing Holm correction pooled ten VH/domain tests and RQ3 difference-in-differences was absent.
defensible_cover: Recompute exact sign-flip tests with Holm over five domains within each RQ; report RQ3 as paired difference-in-differences.

story_hole: MPrime joined the imperfect-domain group only after the corrected validation audit, so its Stage-2 effect is absent from the original five-domain confirmatory family.
defensible_cover: Preserve the preregistered five-domain Holm results and add a separately labelled six-domain extension after MPrime Stage-2 confirmation; existing per-domain CIs/raw p-values do not change, but six-family Holm p-values may stay equal or increase.

story_hole: The paper-plan primary inference comparison is Stage-2 policy versus MCTS, but most present evidence is Stage-1 secondary analysis.
defensible_cover: Finish the submitted Drone gap, then release remaining domain-matched Stage-2 endpoint MCTS in a resource-prioritized order.

story_hole: Terminal checkpoints reuse runs whose stopping was still influenced by validation; this is not strict original-paper early stopping.
defensible_cover: Run STOP-ORIG with training-success stopping and terminal selection, first as a three-seed pilot.

story_hole: Corrected validation removes epoch-1 bias but has weak checkpoint-ranking agreement with test coverage.
defensible_cover: Report rank agreement and regret; consider a larger preregistered validation ensemble without using test scores to tune it.

story_hole: OOM/time-limited MCTS rows are conservative lower bounds and confound algorithm with worker concurrency/memory.
defensible_cover: Deploy lifecycle-safe two-worker/160-GiB resumptions and report both fixed-budget lower bounds and resource sensitivity.

story_hole: Search width differs by domain; a single cross-domain MCTS average would be invalid.
defensible_cover: Keep domain-specific comparisons explicit; use width 5/20 for Block Grouping and Counters, width 20/70 elsewhere.

story_hole: Two-seed cross-domain PW is exploratory and cannot support final statistical claims.
defensible_cover: Expand only promising domain/arm combinations to five matched seeds after current two-seed screen.

story_hole: The original Drone horizon pilot had zero cutoffs and could not test the mechanism.
defensible_cover: Finish fresh aware/unaware 750-action pairs; if cutoffs remain sparse, move to cutoff-rich Counters instances with preregistered limits.

story_hole: Terminal masking repaired two of four failures; two still wandered into failure.
defensible_cover: Use SAFE-CONTEXT for history-aliasing, retain complete decision diagnostics, and classify remaining failure modes.

story_hole: Contextual nodes can multiply node count and memory (diagnostic maximum already >5x).
defensible_cover: Gate full conclusions on peak RSS, node multiplier, collision rate, and matched coverage/runtime—not coverage alone.

story_hole: Physical-state cycle detection may reject a beneficial revisit with a different action history.
defensible_cover: Keep current defensible physical-cycle rule, but add a small contextual-cycle ablation only if collision witnesses show useful revisits.

story_hole: The deterministic 30-minute recensoring is valid descriptive evidence but is not yet a fresh operational hard-cap experiment.
defensible_cover: After the two-seed screen selects promising cells, run fresh same-commit fixed/PW jobs with a hard 30-minute instance cap; this is cheap enough to close directly.

story_hole: Training-plus-search synergy is not yet estimable for most domains because Stage-2 MCTS is held/incomplete.
defensible_cover: Complete selected-checkpoint Stage-2 MCTS; keep Stage-2-final MCTS excluded unless protocol changes.

story_hole: Two of ten seeds select the anchor coefficient, leaving only eight unbiased confirmation seeds per VH.
defensible_cover: Report tuning winners separately from the eight held-out seeds; never present all ten as fully held-out.

story_hole: Published paper scores are single aggregates without seed-level variance.
defensible_cover: Show our mean/CI and descriptive difference only; do not calculate a p-value against the paper number.

story_hole: Historical and fresh MCTS processes are not bitwise reproducible across code/lifecycle builds.
defensible_cover: Use fresh aware and unaware arms from the same commit for causal claims.

story_hole: Legacy continuations reset their validation baseline, overstating continuation improvements.
defensible_cover: Use restored trainer-state metadata and label legacy continuation evidence as compatibility-limited.

story_hole: Non-significance at n=2-5 is not evidence of no effect.
defensible_cover: Label exploratory rows; freeze confirmatory inference only after the preregistered matched seed count is terminal.
